chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Salih ibn 'Uqbah, from Abu al-Hasan Musa عليه السلام, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام gave judgment concerning two horsemen who collided, and one of them died; so he held the surviving one liable for the blood money of the deceased.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام in this report
key_terms.دِيَةَ: blood money; prescribed financial compensation for unlawful killing
key_terms.قَضَى: gave judgment; issued a legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What was the ruling of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام when two horsemen collided and one of them died?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning a collision between two horsemen that resulted in one death. The ruling establishes liability upon the surviving rider for the diyah of the deceased, reflecting principles of adjudication and responsibility in cases of fatal harm.
